commands.name: playback.toggle
commands.description: Play if paused, pause if playing.
commands.label: Play or pause

commands.name: playback.play
commands.description: Start or resume playback.
commands.label: Play

commands.name: playback.pause
commands.description: Pause playback.
commands.label: Pause

commands.name: playback.seek
commands.description: Seek to a position in seconds from the start.
commands.label: Seek

commands.name: playback.skip
commands.description: Move the position forward or back by a number of seconds.
commands.label: Skip

commands.name: playback.rate
commands.description: Set the playback speed from 0.25 to 4, or step it by a delta.
commands.label: Speed

commands.name: audio.volume
commands.description: Set the volume from 0 to 1, or step it by a delta.
commands.label: Volume

commands.name: audio.mute
commands.description: Mute or unmute; with no input it toggles.
commands.label: Mute

commands.name: view.fullscreen
commands.description: Enter or leave fullscreen; with no input it toggles.
commands.label: Fullscreen

commands.name: media.open
commands.description: Ask the person to pick a video file and play it.
commands.label: Open file

commands.name: media.close
commands.description: Stop the current video and return to the start screen.
commands.label: Close video

commands.name: state.read
commands.description: Read the player state: media, tracks, clock (position, playing, rate, volume, muted) and playback.
commands.label: Player state

commands.name: caps.read
commands.description: Read what this browser can do: WebCodecs, File System Access and codec support.
commands.label: Capabilities

commands.name: subtitle.track
commands.description: Choose the subtitle track by list index (-1 turns subtitles off) or id, or step to the next one, Off included.

index.description: Position in subtitle.read tracks; -1 is Off

next.description: Step to the next track, wrapping through Off

commands.label: Subtitle track

commands.name: subtitle.delay
commands.description: Set the subtitle delay in seconds (positive shows subtitles later), or change it by a delta. It resets for each file.
commands.label: Subtitle delay

commands.name: subtitle.style
commands.description: Set caption size, text colour, background opacity and vertical position; the settings persist on this device.

position.description: Distance from the bottom of the picture, in percent

commands.label: Subtitle style

commands.name: subtitle.load-file
commands.description: Load an SRT, WebVTT, ASS or SSA subtitle file for the current video. With no input it asks the person to pick a file; agents pass name and text.

name.description: File name, used for the format and the track label

commands.label: Load subtitles…

commands.name: subtitle.read
commands.description: Read the subtitle tracks, the selected track, the delay, the caption style and the text on screen.
commands.label: Subtitle state

commands.name: subtitle.save
commands.description: Save the selected subtitle track as an SRT or WebVTT file, with the current delay applied. download false returns the text instead.
commands.label: Save subtitles

commands.name: frame.step
commands.description: Show the next (direction 1) or previous (direction -1) frame while paused; if playing, the first step pauses.
commands.label: Step one frame

commands.name: loop.set
commands.description: Set or clear the A-B loop. "cycle" sets A, then B, then clears, at the current position; "set" takes aS and bS; "a" and "b" set one point; "clear" removes the loop.

bS.description: Loop end in seconds (set, b); must be after A

commands.label: A-B loop

commands.name: loop.read
commands.description: Read the A-B loop: phase (off, a, ab), aS and bS in seconds, and what the engine is looping.
commands.label: Loop state

commands.name: chapter.next
commands.description: Seek to the start of the next chapter.
commands.label: Next chapter

commands.name: chapter.previous
commands.description: Seek to the start of the current chapter when more than 3 s into it, otherwise to the previous chapter.
commands.label: Previous chapter

commands.name: chapter.go
commands.description: Seek to the start of the chapter at a zero-based index.
commands.label: Go to chapter

commands.name: chapter.list
commands.description: List the chapters (title, startS, endS) and the current chapter index; panel opens or closes the chapters panel.

panel.description: true opens the panel, false closes it

commands.label: Chapters

commands.name: playback.jump-to
commands.description: Seek to a typed time such as "1:23:45", "83:20", "90" (seconds) or "45%"; with no time it opens the jump-to-time box.

time.description: h:mm:ss, m:ss, seconds, or a percentage like "45%"

commands.label: Jump to time

commands.name: audio.track
commands.description: Switch to the audio track at a zero-based index, or step through the tracks by delta; with no input it moves to the next track.

delta.description: Tracks to move; negative goes back

commands.label: Audio track

commands.name: audio.delay
commands.description: Offset the audio against the video from -10 to 10 seconds (positive plays audio later): set delayS, step by deltaS, or reset to 0.

deltaS.description: Change from the current delay in seconds

commands.label: Audio delay

commands.name: audio.read
commands.description: List the audio tracks (title, language, codec, channels), the selected index and the audio delay; panel opens or closes the audio panel.

panel.description: true opens the panel, false closes it

commands.label: Audio tracks

commands.name: view.snapshot
commands.description: Save the current video frame as a PNG at the size the video is drawn; with save false, return it as a data URL instead.

save.description: false returns the PNG as a data URL and saves nothing; default true

commands.label: Snapshot

commands.name: view.aspect
commands.description: Set the display aspect ratio (auto, 16:9, 4:3, 2.35:1 or 1:1); with no input it moves to the next one.
commands.label: Aspect ratio

commands.name: view.crop
commands.description: Set the crop (none, pillarbox removes the side bars of 4:3 inside 16:9, letterbox removes the bars of 2.35:1 inside 16:9); with no input it moves to the next one.
commands.label: Crop

commands.name: view.read
commands.description: Read the aspect and crop chosen, the view the engine applies, the last snapshot, and the Picture-in-Picture state.
commands.label: Picture state

commands.name: view.pip
commands.description: Open or close Picture-in-Picture (a document window with the video and its controls where the browser offers one, else a video window); with no input it toggles.
commands.label: Picture-in-Picture

commands.name: queue.open-folder
commands.description: Ask the person to pick a folder, queue its videos in natural sort order and play the first.
commands.label: Open folder

commands.name: queue.play
commands.description: Play the queue item at an index (natural folder order, starting at 0).
commands.label: Play queue item

commands.name: queue.next
commands.description: Play the next queue item, following shuffle and repeat-all.
commands.label: Next in queue

commands.name: queue.previous
commands.description: Restart the current item if more than 3 seconds in, else play the previous queue item.
commands.label: Previous in queue

commands.name: queue.repeat
commands.description: Set repeat to off, all or one; with no input it cycles off, all, one.
commands.label: Repeat

commands.name: queue.shuffle
commands.description: Turn shuffle on or off; with no input it toggles. The current item stays current.
commands.label: Shuffle

commands.name: queue.read
commands.description: Read the queue: items, current index, play order, repeat, shuffle, sibling subtitle names and whether the panel is open.
commands.label: Queue

commands.name: queue.panel
commands.description: Open or close the queue panel; with no input it toggles.
commands.label: Queue panel

commands.name: help.show
commands.description: Open or close the keyboard help sheet; with no input it toggles. Returns whether the sheet is open and the shortcuts it lists.
commands.label: Keyboard shortcuts
